'''Inspector-General''' was a [[Military rank/Legends|title]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="TFUII" /> Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[19 BBY/Legends|19]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="date">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to the year [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. Since the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' comic]] places the events of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the title of Inspector-General must have been used during that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Rebu]] held the position of Inspector-General.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Inspector-General was first mentioned in "The [[Nemesis-class gunship|''Nemesis'' Gunship]]" entry in the in-game databank of the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation 3|PlayStation 3]] and [[Wikipedia:Xbox 360|Xbox 360]] versions of ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', a [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released in [[2010]].<ref name="TFUII" />
